type.load: Google Fonts CDN (Almarai:wght@400;700 + Cairo:wght@700;900, display=swap, preconnect) — project convention
type.tabularNums: all numerals (dates, times, period numbers, counts, scores, badges) set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; LTR time ranges isolated with dir=ltr

motion.ruler-pulse: segpulse 3s ease-in-out infinite; opacity 1 -> 0.82 -> 1 on the now segment; the only perpetual motion
motion.panel-transition: panel-in 0.22s ease-out (opacity 0 + translateY(6px) -> settle) on panel/subview activation
motion.micro: 0.15s ease-out hover/fill transitions; skip-link 0.15s; toast-in 0.2s ease-out, 0.2s opacity dismiss
motion.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce -> animation/transition none !important on all elements
